upstream_comment: Frontier/open model pool on our serving host (measured 2026-07-22). weight_bytes = sum of *.safetensors on disk; params_b = known parameter count (billions); serve_quant = dtype used for serving (awq/gptq 4-bit where a quantized dir exists, else bf16). MoE models list active_b. Stub dirs (config-only, no weights) excluded. This is the VRAM-packing substrate for the cluster case study; benchmark scores live in pool_scores.csv.
